NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, do hereby approve the acquisition of immovableproperty, shown in the following Schedule as it is required by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board for constructionof water purification unit and official quarters under Gawarammana and Bogahakumbura integrated Water Supply Project.
RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning and
Water Supply.Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply,No. 35, “Lakdiya Medura”,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,21st August, 2018.5/2/1/1411
SCHEDULE

The allotment of land called Wrauwk Waththa Glench portion field No. 6 situated in the village of WrauwkWaththa Glench portion field No. 6 in the Grama Niladhari Division Ambewela - A in the Divisional Secretary’s divisionof Welimada in Badulla District containing of about 02 Acres 02 Roodes and bounded as follows :—

North by:Balance portion of the land and Raindapola - Ambewela Road ;East by:Balance portion of the land and Raindapola - Ambewela Road ;South by:Ambewela irrigation Canal ;West by:Balance portion of the land and Raindapola - Ambewela Road.
Name and address of the claimant :Cheif Executive Officer,Wrauwk Haggala Waththa,Malwaththa Weli Plantation Company,Ambewela.
